scope: Separate WUP 2025 population-ranked follow-on cohort, original global ranks 1001–1100. Does not replace or modify the original top-1000 roster or evidence.

source.populationSource: Official UN WUP 2025 Year=2025 City_Code, Pop, PWCent_Lat, PWCent_Long
source.organization: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
source.publication: World Urbanization Prospects: The 2025 Revision, Online Edition
source.identity: City_Code is the WUP settlement identity; Year=2025 PWCent fields are population-weighted settlement points, not municipal boundaries or parcel-coverage claims.

priorCohortContext.preservation: Counts supplied for prior root-reviewed cohort; this file is an independent 1001–1100 cohort roster.

classificationMethod: Temporary copy of the existing queue builder using the same repository evidence roots; exact WUP source/hash retained. No city research was performed. Root-directed manual identity resolution marks rank 1015 Salt Lake City as the same settlement as the verified Utah-capital parcel sample (9.66 km).
